title: At Issue | Is Carney’s Europe pivot in Canada’s best interest?
text:
At Issue | Is Carney’s Europe pivot in Canada’s best interest?

At Issue this week: Prime Minister Mark Carney moves to deepen ties with the European Union, but is it in Canada’s best interest? The Liberals try to lure foreign investment. And Stephen Harper stands behind the decision to walk away from U.S. trade talks.
